text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess has invited me to visit
a shrine
for New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I've decided that this is the year
I'll
conduct myself in a way truly
befitting a princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll be the princess-iest princess to ever
princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
N-no, not at all. What I aspire to
become is my
perfect self—true to both
my princess ideals and
my own nature!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I won't go back to the days of simply
imitating
princess behavior. And I won't
be doing things
like elegance training
any longer either.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What I lacked was dignity as a runner. A
selfish
princess who just does whatever
she wants is
nothing but an
embarrassment.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I want to be accepted for who I am. I
need to
adopt a mental attitude that
everyone will
respect.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Fan
text_block_list.text:
It's Kawakami Princess! I can't wait to see
you run
in the Kinko Sho!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you very much. I appreciate
your
support!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Fan
text_block_list.text:
You were so amazing in the Classics last
year,
too! You really stood out among
your peers.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...No, that can't be the case. I still have
so much
to learn from everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oho... ohohoho... My apologies, but I
should be
off now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So saying, Kawakami Princess gently
raises her
skirt and lifts her right foot,
and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: KA-SPLAAAT!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She slips and falls over stupendously.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm terribly sorry! I have no injuries, so
please do
not concern yourself!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Are you really okay?! There's a first-aid
room
right nearby!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes, I'm really fine! A g-good day to
you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Kawakami, what are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll pass on the amazake... I still haven't
mastered
the proper etiquette required
when drinking it.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, be careful, Trainer! There's a cat
walking
past. Let's pass through once it's
gone.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Th-that's because I decided to change!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I realized I can't continue being the
same person I
was until now.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gah! Is it that time already?! I won't
make it to my
flower arrangement class!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I started last month. It's very
graceful... And
queen-like, wouldn't you
agree?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's a soccer ball...

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! Would you mind kicking the ball
back to
me?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, that's my specialty! You'd better
back up
a bit! I'm about to send this—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Isn't that Kawakami Princess? She
was on the TV
recently...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're right. She made that princess
declaration,
right? Said she wouldn't do
anything undignified...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I'll just carry the ball over to
you.
Please wait just a moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess gently picks up the
soccer
ball.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like she's holding herself back.
As she
begins walking over, I feel
compelled to say...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like she's holding herself back.
As she
begins walking over, I feel
compelled to say...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I gently take the ball from Kawakami
Princess.

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Thanks a lot!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No, I... I'm not forcing anything...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: One step at a time...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I walk along the riverbank with
Kawakami Princess
as the evening sun
sets.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if this path we're on doesn't end up
leading
to her goal, all we have to do is
pick another one
when that time comes.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: What? Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take Kawakami Princess's hand and run
over to
the boys playing soccer.

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Wow! You two are pretty good at this!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hehe, yes, so did I...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It was... very enjoyable.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take the ball from Kawakami Princess
and pull
my leg back as far as I can.
Then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Swish!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer?! You completely whiffed it...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... You packed way too much
energy into
it. Just what were you
thinking?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look at Kawakami Princess's face and
see her
usual authentic smile.
